Autonomous register / password-reset capture on a real public site

positional arguments:
  name         Site name for trajectories/site_<name>
  signup_url   The signup page URL
  instruction  Override the generated user goal (register only)

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --reset      Register + verify, then a full forgot-password reset (also:
               `reset ...`)
